findings.issue: derivedRunIds is unbounded; the only cap is the schema's parents max(100) throwing inside finish at line 103, which surfaces as an opaque parse failure rather than a named stale/limit error.
findings.minimalFix: Check new Set(data.derivedRunIds).size <= 100 before the loop and throw a descriptive error (e.g. 'assistant_deriveed_parent_limit') instead of relying on the schema parse.

findings.issue: A derivedRunId that is visible but has no stored lineage (untracked run) is silently skipped rather than pinned or rejected, so such a run influences the child without any existence/hash dependency. This is consistent with the prior accepted scope (no lineage means nothing to pin), but it is untested.
findings.minimalFix: Add a test (or explicit comment plus assertion) covering derivedRunIds pointing at a visible lineage-less run, documenting intended skip behavior.

findings.issue: The child fixture with an external (flag-absent) parent is only asserted for propagation of the epoch change; the negative case 'external parent makes child non-visible/ineligible' is covered indirectly in the later test (line 70-75) but not with the legacy-flag path through isRunVisible there.
findings.minimalFix: Add expect(gate.isRunVisible('child')).toBe(false) while epoch is still 2 to assert legacy parents are conservatively external before the epoch mutation.
